title: t27c on gft_smul.t27 -- a sign is one bit, native
desc: t27c 0.5.1 and zig 0.16.0 in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x86_64), spec at t27 72f793357: all 3 tests pass natively, none vacuous; a sign that is always 0 makes exactly one test fail, m2; git restores the spec.
commands: sed -i 's/if (sgn != sb) { sgn = 1; } else { sgn = 0; }/sgn = 0;/' specs/ternary/gft_smul.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
